en: Most days you'd hop the lily pads and slide over the water. Today the pads are tied up, so the walkway takes you to the dock.
Water-type Pokémon don't like Grass and Electric moves. Remember that!
This Gym may feel like a resort, but the Gym Leader's no pushover! Here's a little something. Stay sharp!
If you're looking for the Gym Leader, he went swimming off into the sea, shouting about the waves! Try looking for him.
You beat Marlon! Now you've got every Badge in Unova. That's something to shout about!
Sup! Here already, huh? You look strong! Shoots! Let's do this!
You don't just look strong, you're strong for real! I got swept right away, yo.
Oh yeah. I was so surprised I almost forgot! I've gotta give you this.
{player} received the Wave Badge from Marlon!
That's the Wave Badge, Unova's newest Gym Badge! Pretty sweet, right? Now you've got all eight, so any Pokémon will listen to you.
Oh yeah, I've got a TM for you too.
Use it when the waves are with you, 'K? Shoots! I'm off, then. Hope it comes in handy!
Waves can be rough or calm, but it's still the same sea. There's lots of ways to look at the same thing, yo.
Whoa, you forgot your TM! Here.
